title: Labcorp launches Marker genetic health panel
excerpt: The Marker by Labcorp panel analyzes 163 genes linked to more than 100 medically actionable conditions and was scheduled to become available August 3, 2026.
summary: The issuer release is the only identified near-alert product event. It supports product breadth but provides no adoption, revenue, margin, or investment economics sufficient to explain or value the July 28 move.
